question: Which of the following two teams played against each other in the first match of IPL 2021?

options.text: Mumbai Indians and Royal Challengers Bangalore
Kolkata Knight Riders and Rajasthan Royals
Chennai Super Kings and Sunrisers Hyderabad

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai Indians and Royal Challengers Bangalore.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The two teams which played against each other in the first match of IPL 2021 were Mumbai Indians and Royal Challengers Bangalore.
 
• The MS Dhoni-led **Chennai Super Kings** (CSK) lifted their 4th IPL title after defeating the Eoin Morgan-led Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) by 27 runs in IPL 2021.
 
• The first half of IPL was played in India, while the second half was played in **UAE**. The finals were held at **Dubai International Stadium**.
 
• **Eoin Morgan** is the captain of the Runner up team i.e Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR). He is from England.
